[unclear] the Victors [unclear] and [unclear] and [unclear]
Homage! Of all the Victors there are, past, not yet come, and present, you, virtuous lady,
are the mother; you, goddess, [mother] of the Victors' heirs, having the nature that is without inherent nature. The names of her who became the Buddha's mother,
virtuous lady, I shall proclaim; those who wish for prosperity, listen!
The perfection of wisdom, and omniscience, and the knowledge of all aspects of the path
